text:
sophia: opened PR to simplify the rate/quota docs and provide a compact copy-paste bundle: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7001
sophia: main items: replace legacy header examples, add a tiny billing CSV sample, and fix a bunch of broken dashboard anchors that point to staging.
eli: will review. One ask: can we include both a per-minute PromQL example for live monitoring and a 30-day increase for billing preview? customers always ask for both.
maria: agree. Also please standardize the SDK header snippet to the canonical form we landed on in SDKv2 to avoid future churn.
sophia: using header: `X-Redwood-Usage: acct="acct_ABC", units=120, unit_type="tokens"` in the PR; added a short note to never include real keys.
eli: added PromQL examples in the PR: `sum(rate(redwood_usage_tokens_total[1m])) by (customer)` and `sum(increase(redwood_usage_tokens_total[30d])) by (customer)` and a tiny CSV at /examples/billing-preview.csv with sample calculations.
ops-bot: note: panel ids differ between prod and staging; link to the dashboard slug (`/d/usage/overview`) rather than panel anchor for stable links. If anchor needed please open OPS ticket.
maria: editorial: change tier label 'starter' -> 'growth' in the pricing table and keep a legacy-name mapping table. Also reword quota section from "requests blocked" to "requests may return 429 or be routed to a fallback model depending on customer policy".
eli: fixed wording and updated the tiny SVG timeline (minute buckets -> rollup -> invoice window -> fallback). Also swapped any internal grafana org links for slug URLs.
docs-bot: Preview: https://deploy-preview-7001--docs.redwood.ai  please check the CSV download, that the timeline renders, and the header snippet formatting in both code and prose.
sophia: thanks all. If preview is green I'll merge after one final quick pass. Aiming to ship before tomorrow's docs freeze. :thumbsup:
